tagline: Talk-to-text that works even when the internet doesn't.
brief: Offline-first voice dictation for developers and professionals (Linux + Windows). Local STT by default, optional cloud boost. The brand must feel robust, beautiful, quiet and precise — no hype.
criteria: Success: ownable beyond the waveform cliché, readable at 16 px tray size, works in one colour and reversed, carries the teal/coral/cream equity, feels at home in a terminal and a README.

concepts.name: Dictation Comma
concepts.idea: The smallest unit of written speech: voice, written down.
rationale: Derived from what dictation does — speech becomes text — not from what microphones look like
No mic, no broadcast arcs, no equalizer bars: clear of every category cliché
Two shapes (head + tail) survive 16 px, one colour, embroidery and favicon
The coral comma after the wordmark echoes the symbol in type
Cream on teal clears 5.4:1 contrast; the palette carries over from the existing UI

recommendation: Dictation Comma, approved at the concept checkpoint: proceed to rollout with the kit in brand/kit.
next_steps: Swap the repo's susurro-logo.svg for the new primary symbol
Wire the web icon set into the Tauri app and the site head snippet
Run a trademark/reverse-image search before first public release
